categories.main_business_segments: Grandit Co., Ltd. (Zhongjuxin) primarily operates in the semiconductor materials sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of electronic wet chemicals, electronic specialty gases, and precursor materials. These products are essential for manufacturing processes in integrated circuits, display panels, and photovoltaic industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced production technologies including ultra-pure chemical synthesis, purification, and packaging technologies tailored for semiconductor-grade materials. It employs precise process controls for product purity, particle size, and impurity levels, supported by high-precision analytical instruments. R&D efforts focus on process optimization, new product development, and proprietary formulations to meet evolving semiconductor manufacturing requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor wafer manufacturers, display panel producers, and photovoltaic cell manufacturers. Major clients include leading integrated circuit companies such as SMIC, Changjiang Storage, Huahong Group, SK Hynix, and others. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong presence in China and exports to Taiwan and South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major production facilities in Quzhou and Hubei provinces. It also has a growing international footprint with sales and supply relationships in Taiwan, South Korea, and other overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhongjuxin operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in the production of critical raw materials and chemicals used in semiconductor wafer fabrication and related processes. It supplies essential inputs for chip manufacturing but does not engage in chip design or final product assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in electronic wet chemicals, specialty gases, and precursor materials, with significant R&D investments (~7.1% of revenue). Strategic initiatives include developing advanced precursor materials for ALD processes, formula-based functional chemicals, and expanding production capacity. It also focuses on digital transformation, operational excellence, and expanding its product portfolio to support advanced semiconductor manufacturing nodes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic wet chemicals, specialty gases, and precursor materials to semiconductor manufacturers and related industries. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by agency and consignment sales, with order-driven production and inventory management aligned to customer demand.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhongjuxin is one of the leading domestic producers of semiconductor-grade electronic chemicals and gases in China, competing with international suppliers from Europe, Japan, and the US. It has achieved significant breakthroughs in product quality and scale, breaking international monopolies in certain product categories and gaining recognition as a key domestic supplier.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, representing a 15.16% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 10 million, down 26.87% from the previous year, reflecting market competition and increased R&D and operational costs. Total assets stood at RMB 4.01 billion, with steady growth in production volumes and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhongjuxin emphasizes high product purity, stable quality, and comprehensive product categories covering electronic wet chemicals, specialty gases, and precursor materials. Its competitive edge lies in its advanced technology, strong R&D capabilities, and ability to provide customized solutions aligned with customer manufacturing processes. The company also highlights its role in supporting domestic semiconductor industry self-sufficiency and breaking foreign technology monopolies.
